_comment: A deliberate ceiling on wall clock, not on coverage: the suite may grow as the product does (a test is cheap; a slow suite is not). max_single_test_s is CI-runner headroom (the desktop's slowest test is ~10 s); a test that needs more belongs in the heavy lane (.config/nextest.toml default-filter). max_sum_s is the CPU ceiling; `just ratchet` tightens it to the last measured run. There is no test-count ceiling and there must not be one: counting tests punished the coverage the release needs.
